# ferentin_mcp_providers (Data Source)

List every entry in the global MCP provider catalog. Returns one row per provider with the minimum fields useful for `for_each` patterns.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Plural — lists every provider in the global catalog.
data "ferentin_mcp_providers" "all" {}

output "provider_slugs" {
  value = [for p in data.ferentin_mcp_providers.all.providers : p.slug]
}
```
